newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Warehouse sees fall in H2 operating profit.
newsitem.headline: Warehouse sees fall in H2 operating profit.

text.p: New Zealand discount retailer The Warehouse Ltd said on Wednesday it expected its operating profit in the second half year to be "considerably less" than that of the first six months to January 31.
The company announced a net profit of NZ$25.3 million ($17.5 million) for the period, and declared a dividend of 6.0 cents per share.
In a statement Warehouse said that, based on its trading performance and market conditions, the directors were confident of achieving a sound financial result for the full year.
